dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: It feels like déjà vu. We've talked about sách in this coffee shop before, haven't we?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I don't remember much... But speaking of sách, I just finished reading "Sapiens" by Yuval Noah Harari. Have you đọc any of his works?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hmm, I don't like đọc science sách. I prefer classical Russian novels. Dostoevsky is my favorite author. Have you đọc "Crime and Punishment"?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I've tried to đọc it several times but never finished. Russian sách are too... deep and sad. I prefer đọc sách about travel and cultures of different countries. But maybe I should try Dostoevsky again. Can you recommend any of his sách that are easier to đọc?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: There are no "easy to đọc" ones. Russian literature requires deep thinking. But... if you really want to try, I could lend you my copy of "The Idiot." That was the first Dostoevsky sách I đọc.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Thank you, I'll try to đọc it. If I have any questions about the sách, could I ask you? Perhaps we could discuss sách while having coffee...
